description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which is an Android Fragment that contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages. It manages setting up the UI components such as ScrollView and LogView, and handles updating the scroll position when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs in a scrollable, monospace TextView. It inflates a ScrollView containing a LogView, configures appearance and padding, and provides a method to retrieve the LogView instance.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and prepares the view hierarchy for the fragment, setting up a listener on the LogView to keep the scroll at the bottom when new text is added.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
